caption: This shio broth ramen features a clear, golden-yellow, glossy soup with thin noodles and green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy rim, it includes dark green nori, golden-brown chashu pork, pale yellow menma, and a pale pink naruto fish cake. Set on a wooden table with warm brown grain and glossy reflections.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and glossy reflections from ambient light.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with golden-brown, slightly crispy edges and tender, pale interior.
The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, and glossy, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
Naruto fish cake: round, pale pink swirl center, creamy white base, slightly textured surface.
